subject: Life Sciences
topic: Homeostasis: carbon dioxide, salts and thyroxine

items.q: Receptors that detect a rise in blood CO₂ are found in the:
items.qAf: Reseptore wat ’n styging in bloed-CO₂ bespeur, word gevind in die:
items.explain: Chemoreceptors in the carotid and aortic bodies (and the medulla) detect CO₂.
items.explainAf: Chemoreseptore in die karotis- en aortaliggaampies (en die medulla) bespeur CO₂.

items.q: During exercise, blood CO₂ rises. The medulla oblongata responds by:
items.qAf: Tydens oefening styg bloed-CO₂. Die medulla oblongata reageer deur:
options: increasing breathing rate and heart rate
items.explain: Faster breathing removes CO₂ and the faster heart carries it to the lungs.
items.explainAf: Vinniger asemhaling verwyder CO₂ en die vinniger hart vervoer dit na die longe.

items.q: Regulation of CO₂ is an example of negative feedback because:
items.qAf: Regulering van CO₂ is ’n voorbeeld van negatiewe terugvoer omdat:
options: the response reverses the original change
optionsAf: die reaksie die oorspronklike verandering omkeer
items.explain: Negative feedback brings the level back to normal.
items.explainAf: Negatiewe terugvoer bring die vlak terug na normaal.

items.q: When the sodium level of the blood is low, the adrenal cortex secretes:
items.qAf: Wanneer die natriumvlak van die bloed laag is, skei die adrenale korteks af:
items.explain: Aldosterone makes the kidney tubules reabsorb more Na⁺.
items.explainAf: Aldosteroon laat die nierbuisies meer Na⁺ herabsorbeer.

items.q: If the thyroxine level is high, the pituitary gland:
items.qAf: As die tiroksienvlak hoog is, sal die pituïtêre klier:
optionsAf: ophou om ADH af te skei
items.explain: High thyroxine inhibits TSH secretion (negative feedback).
Thyroxine regulates the rate of metabolism in body cells.
items.explainAf: Tiroksien reguleer die tempo van metabolisme in liggaamselle.
